questions.text: CAASM Software:

options.label: CAASM software is a category of cybersecurity solutions designed to help organizations identify, monitor, and manage all of their cyber assets (both internal and external), while continuously analyzing the associated attack surface.  In simpler terms, it gives security teams a comprehensive, timely inventory of assets and highlights any maintenance needed and/or any risks associated with each asset
There are three different pricing models for CAASM
In a per user based pricing model, there is a cost for each user who has devices which are monitored on the platform, and your annual cost is based on the total # of users
In a per device based pricing model, there is a small cost for each device  monitored on the platform, and your annual cost is based on the total # of devices

Tier based pricing is based on the number of assets (users and devices), the number of assets is grouped into different tiers (e.g., 1-999, 1,000-4,999).  Each tier has an associated price point, and your cost is tied to the tier which includes your total # of assets
